label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark is leading the U.S. Open at 7-under after one hole, with Matt Fitzpatrick, Xander Schauffele, Sam Stevens, and Tom Kim tied at 3-under.

items.headline: Niemann owns penalty at U.S. Open
items.text: Joaquin Niemann took a two-stroke penalty for throwing a club 50 yards at the U.S. Open, admitted it was poor behavior, then carded a 65 to make the cut after a first-round 78.

items.headline: DeChambeau faces PGA Tour penalty
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau could incur a significant penalty including fines and loss of elite event status if he returns to the PGA Tour, with LIV funding ending after 2026 and his contract expiring.
